evidence.detail: Recovered semantic source map identifies rs/s/n/a as rs.plugins.notifications.NotificationsConfig.
The interface extends the shared config contract and carries exact config-group key 'notifications'.
Config items cover de-aggro, superior spawn and private-message alerts plus tray, focus, sound, timeout, FlashNotification, focused-client policy and flash color.
rs/s/n/b provides this exact config interface from ConfigManager and consults its values before dispatching messages through R14 Notifier.

evidence.detail: Recovered semantic source map identifies rs/s/n/b as rs.plugins.notifications.NotificationsPlugin.
The class extends the plugin base and its exact runtime descriptor is title 'Notifications', key 'notifications', tags ['notify','alert','notification'], hidden=true.
The plugin injects R14 Notifier and NotificationsConfig and routes qualifying events to Notifier with TrayIcon message types.
Subscribed handlers cover de-aggro timer, superior slayer/boss spawn and private-message notifications; focus changes reset the de-aggro suppression flag.

candidates.note: Exact source identity is corroborated by the runtime plugin descriptor, event surface and direct Notifier/config pairing.
